target: forge.sh — across pr-create, pr-state, pr-close and an https push the token is in no argv log and no file created in the sandbox, TMPDIR or /tmp (control: auth=present and the git env carried it)
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
TOK=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
export FORGE_TOKEN=$TOK
B="/api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests"
fx_http "GET $B?source_branch=feat&state=opened" 200 '[]'
fx_http "POST $B" 201 '{"iid":3,"web_url":"https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj/-/merge_requests/3"}'
fx_http "GET $B/3" 200 '{"state":"opened"}'
fx_http "PUT $B/3" 200 '{"state":"closed"}'
U=https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj/-/merge_requests/3
leaks=0; rcs=0
chk() { [[ $FX_RC -eq 0 ]] || rcs=$FX_RC; if printf '%s%s' "$FX_OUT" "$FX_ERR" | grep -qF -- "$TOK"; then leaks=$((leaks+1)); fi; }
fx_run pr-create --head feat --base main --title T --body-file body.md; chk
fx_run pr-state "$U"; chk
fx_run pr-close "$U"; chk
fx_run push feat; chk
n=$(grep -c 'auth=present' "$FORGE_MOCK_DIR/requests.log" 2>/dev/null); [[ ${n:-0} -ge 3 ]] && echo auth_ok=yes || echo auth_ok=no
echo "auth_absent=$(grep -c 'auth=absent' "$FORGE_MOCK_DIR/requests.log" 2>/dev/null)"
tail -1 "$FORGE_MOCK_DIR/git-push.log" 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'value_has_token=[a-z]*'
echo "leaks_in_output=$leaks"; echo "all.rc=$rcs"
fx_tokscan "$TOK"
fx_done
